state_separation.task_status: server-side command/job interpretation; never inferred solely from browser_state when a Result is absent

suppression.duplicate_rule: event_id already seen OR sequence_no equals last accepted sequence for command_id => SUPPRESS_DUPLICATE
suppression.stale_rule: sequence_no lower than last accepted sequence for command_id => SUPPRESS_STALE
suppression.accepted_rule: sequence_no greater than last accepted sequence for command_id

cycle_terminal_rule: emit CYCLE_BROWSER_TERMINAL when every registered worker latest browser_state is one of COMPLETE/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN
durability: append accepted events + atomic latest-per-command projection + cycle snapshot; restart rebuilds from durable snapshot/event log
